description: WP-G5 — player-controlled NO ESCAPE (Shadowkeepers, 2 CP). Fixture cus11e_c5_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE, P2 Custodes, round 2). Setup privileges as cus11e_no_escape (detachment flip, auto wound allocation, Moment Shackle spent, unreadied, straight to the Orks' Movement phase) plus a seeded 2D6. The Ork player falls the Boyz back 2.5"; a real click on Use on Custodian Guard A spends 2 CP and opens the NO ESCAPE dialog: the Custodes player clicks Roll Charge, picks the Boyz (the only unit that fell back; the Meganobz are never offered), clicks Charge, selects the Guard (Ctrl+A), drags it 2.6" north into engagement range and clicks End This Unit's Move: the charge is judged by the core charge-move rules and the Guard ends engaged with Fights First; the Ork player has the phase back.
